about: SCION 19 · Moho Pro — Smart-Bone Character Laboratory: every asset in the film, where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it. Nothing was found, fetched or photographed: every picture element is a vector shape written in code here, every sound synthesized here.

assets.what: the dog: a bone hierarchy (root, pelvis, spine, withers, neck, head, two view-control bones, 3-bone IK chains for each of four legs, 3 tail bones, 2 ears: 25 bones counting both sides) and its vector mesh (sculpted masses bound to the bones, drawn as one variable-width ink contour over a flat fill)
assets.source: made here: build/rig.js (SHEET, buildDog); proportions drawn by eye, no reference images

assets.what: the head switch layer: five drawings (profile, three-quarter front, front, three-quarter back, back; the other three of eight views are their mirrors), chosen by the view_head bone's angle snapped to 45 degrees
assets.source: made here: build/rig.js drawHead(); all views share one head landmark sheet (HEAD) so heights and joint positions agree, see proof/rig_tests.json T1

assets.what: six Smart-Bone corrective actions (neck-turn, spine-curl, leg-fold-hind, leg-fold-fore, head-down, jaw-rest), each keyed on a bone angle
assets.source: made here: build/rig.js CORRECTIONS; versioned table in proof/corrections.json

assets.what: the dog's controls per frame (view bones, lie, head, rest, look, ears, tail, gait footfalls) and the person's and door's
assets.source: made here: build/perform.js, reading paeleo/handmade/score/threshold-score.json (the PAELEO score, Bolas)
assets.rights: made here; the score is the project's own

assets.what: the person: capsule limbs on a small IK rig, same ink line and flat fills; a drawn, unidentifiable face
house in section (hatched cut wall, jamb, sill, door leaf), lit room (lamp, picture, rug), porch boards, rail and posts, stool, dusk sky bands, hills, trees, moon, paper grain
assets.source: made here: build/world.js drawPlace(), drawWall(), drawStool(), makeGrain()

assets.what: room tone and crickets, the person's voice (formant synthesis: Come here, Come here, It's all right x2, Come in), paw taps at the gait's measured touch-downs, settle thuds, a sigh, door creak, room hum
Literata, JetBrains Mono, Big Shoulders Display for the cards and dialogue
assets.source: tools/paeleo/fonts/ (read in place, not copied); SIL Open Font License

not_used: No kit footage, masks, Quick, Draw! drawings or archive shots were used; no images from the web; no model-generated images.
